title: Glass Card
description: Reusable frosted-glass surface for content groups with subtle lift and focus treatment. Rest-state look lives here; the hover state (background/border-color/box-shadow/outline swap), the transition/transform, and the backdrop-filter blur all stay in src/scss/components.scss — a bare &:hover in this css field is silently dropped, same class of bug as the already-documented @media/@supports stripping.
